name: Agashi Jain Shwetambar Maha Tirth
description:
A Jain Temple, whereby presiding deity of Tirthankar Munisuvrat Swami in black color, is seated in a lotus posture, of height 1.25 meters in a shrine at Chal Peth in the village of Agashi.

The idol which had manifested itself here in the Chakreśvar lake, Nala-Sopara belongs to remote past. It was ceremonially installed once again in the newly constructed temple here on Falgun Krishna 2 in Vikram year 1892 by Shri Motisha Sheth.

There is a dharamshala close to the temple with all facilities and a bhojanshala for dry snacks and meals too.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The temple is home to an 11.5 lakh-year-old ancient idol of Shri Munisuvrat Swami, also known as Jivit Swami, believed to be from the time of the Tirthankara himself. This sacred idol holds great historical and spiritual importance.

In front of the main temple is a small shrine of Kshetrapalji (Deri), near which lies a large well that contains turtles and fish, symbolically linked to Swami’s lanchhan (turtle 🐢).

The main temple is grand and beautifully built, with a sacred tree at the entrance adding to the divine atmosphere.

Devotees are well accommodated with AC Dharamshala rooms, and the temple is especially crowded on Saturdays.

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Sakpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Ichhapurti Underground Ganpati Mandir in Wagholi is a remarkable spiritual site that offers a distinct departure from the typical temple experience. What makes it truly special is its unique location, situated 15 feet below the earth's surface. According to local history, the temple was constructed after a Swayambhu (self-manifested) idol of Lord Ganesha was discovered buried at this site. Rather than moving the idol to a traditional hilltop or ground-level structure, the devotees chose to build the temple downward, creating a subterranean sanctuary that feels sheltered from the outside world.
​Descending the stairs into the temple, visitors are immediately met with a noticeable drop in temperature and a profound sense of quiet. The interior is largely finished with warm wood paneling, which enhances the acoustics and creates an intimate, meditative environment. Because the sanctum is underground, the typical city noises of Nallasopara fade away, allowing for a focused and peaceful "Darshan." The idol itself, known as Ichhapurti (the fulfiller of desires), is beautifully adorned and serves as a powerful focal point for prayer and reflection.
​The temple is also conveniently located within a larger spiritual hub. Being part of the Fulare Charitable Trust complex, it sits right alongside the wooden-styled Swami Samarth Math and near the Wagheshwari Devi Temple. This proximity allows visitors to experience a complete "pilgrimage" within a single walking radius. Whether you are a devout follower or simply someone interested in unique architecture, the underground temple is a "must-visit" for its serene energy and the fascinating story behind its creation.

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
🙏😊"Icchapurti Ganpati Mandir – Where Wishes Truly Come True!"
Hidden beneath the ground in a peaceful corner of Wagholi, this small yet divine underground Ganpati Mandir is a true gem. As soon as you step inside, the sight of Lord Ganpati’s small and adorable idol fills your heart with calmness and devotion. It’s a place where your mind becomes still, and your prayers feel heard.

Many believe that any wish made here with a pure heart gets fulfilled, and honestly, it does feel magical. The vibe around Bappa is so positive, it’s like leaving all your worries at His feet. Each visit brings a sense of comfort and deep spiritual connection.

The best part? The journey itself. A peaceful bike ride through lush coconut trees, especially in the evening, is a whole experience in itself. The scenic views are breathtaking!

Right outside the temple, there’s a cute little garden with colorful flowers, where you can relax, take pictures, and kids can play too. And even during the monsoon season, this place looks like a beautiful painting — green, fresh, and full of peace.🙏🙏🙏🙏😊😊😊

हमें आप सभी को यह सूचित करते हुए अत्यंत हर्ष हो रहा है कि "श्री इच्छापूर्ति दुर्गा माता मंदिर" में बच्चों के उज्ज्वल भविष्य और आध्यात्मिक विकास हेतु *"श्रीमद्भागवत गीता का पारायण (नियमित पाठ)"* का आयोजन किया जा रहा है।
*📜 विवरण इस प्रकार है:*
प्रारंभ तिथि: रविवार, १४ दिसंबर २०२५
समय: प्रत्येक रविवार, शाम ०५:०० बजे से
स्थान: श्री इच्छापूर्ति दुर्गा माता मंदिर।

*उद्देश्य:*
नन्हे बच्चों को हमारी गौरवशाली संस्कृति से जोड़ना, एकाग्रता बढ़ाना और गीता के अनमोल जीवन उपदेशों को सरल भाषा में समझाना।
*विशेष आग्रह:*
सभी अभिभावकों से विनम्र निवेदन है कि अपने बच्चों को इस पावन आयोजन में अवश्य भेजें और उन्हें धर्म व ज्ञान के इस मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करें।
*"आज के बच्चे, कल के संस्कारित नागरिक।"*
*धन्यवाद।*
*— श्री इच्छापूर्ति दुर्गा माता धर्म रक्षा समिति।*
